parameters.query:
SELECT direction, message_text, created_at
FROM conversations
WHERE business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND customer_number = '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

messageValues.message:
You are a Delivery Info Extraction AI.
Your job is to read the customer messages and determine if they have provided BOTH their full delivery address AND a payment method.

You MUST output ONLY valid JSON matching this exact structure (no other text):
has_delivery_info: true or false
delivery_address: the address they gave or null
payment_method: cash_on_delivery or bank_transfer or null

If the customer gave an address (like a city, road, or location name) AND mentioned Cash on Delivery or Bank Transfer, then has_delivery_info is true.
Otherwise has_delivery_info is false.

Do not say anything else. Do not be conversational. Only output the raw JSON values.

parameters.query:
-- Fetch the last bulk quote to reconstruct the order
SELECT message_text, created_at
FROM conversations
WHERE business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND customer_number = '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}'
  AND direction = 'outbound'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO customers (business_id, phone_number, total_orders, last_order_date)
VALUES ('{{ $json.business_id }}', '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}', 1, now())
ON CONFLICT (business_id, phone_number)
DO UPDATE SET total_orders = customers.total_orders + 1, last_order_date = now()
RETURNING id AS customer_id, total_orders;

INSERT INTO orders
  (business_id, customer_id, customer_number, items, total_price, discount_applied, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.business_id }}',
  '{{ $json.customer_id }}',
  '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.phoneNumber }}',
  '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.items }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.total_price }},
  {{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.discount_applied }},
  'confirmed'
)
RETURNING id AS order_id;

INSERT INTO conversations (business_id, customer_number, direction, message_text)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Parse Delivery Info').item.json.business_id }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Delivery Info').item.json.phoneNumber }}',
  'outbound',
  'Order confirmed ΓÇö delivery details collected and confirmation sent.'
);
UPDATE customers SET active_flow = NULL WHERE phone_number = '{{ $("Workflow Input").first().json.phoneNumber }}' AND business_id = '{{ $("Workflow Input").first().json.business_id }}';
